description: This Java class, CollectionSheetTransactionDataValidator, is a validation utility for collection sheet transaction data in the Fineract project. It validates JSON input for various transaction types such as disbursements, repayments, attendance details, and savings due transactions, ensuring all required fields are present and adhere to business rules before processing.

classes.name: CollectionSheetTransactionDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON input related to collection sheet transactions, including disbursements, repayments, attendance, and savings transactions, ensuring data integrity and adherence to business rules.

methods.name: validateTransaction
methods.description: Validates a collection sheet transaction JSON command, checking for required fields, unsupported parameters, and consistency of transaction details.

methods.name: validateIndividualCollectionSheet
methods.description: Validates an individual collection sheet JSON command, including date validation and transaction details, for individual collection sheet processing.

methods.name: validateAttendanceDetails
methods.description: Validates client attendance data within the collection sheet JSON.

methods.name: validateDisbursementTransactions
methods.description: Validates disbursement transaction details within the JSON input.

methods.name: validateRepaymentTransactions
methods.description: Validates repayment transaction details within the JSON input.

methods.name: validateSavingsDueTransactions
methods.description: Validates savings due transaction details within the JSON input.

methods.name: validatePaymentDetails
methods.description: Validates payment-related details such as payment type and account information.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if any data validation errors were accumulated.
